title: .NET Fullstack Developer(.net core+Angular+Azure (4+ Years)
description:
**Company Description** 
 techvantage.ai helps organizations solve complex business challenges and accelerate innovation by leveraging the full spectrum of AI, from advanced analytics and machine learning to enterprise\-scale automation. As pioneers in Agentic AI, the company builds autonomous systems that sense, decide, and act, enabling enterprises to operate with greater precision and adaptability. techvantage.ai partners with leading organizations across Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Telecom, Media, Retail, and Automotive. Its solutions are designed to drive efficiency, agility, and breakthrough results, setting the foundation for the next generation of intelligent enterprise automation.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time remote role for a .NET Fullstack Developer (.NET Core \+ Angular \+ Azure) with 4\+ years of experience. The developer will design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using .NET Core for back\-end services and Angular for front\-end interfaces. Responsibilities include implementing Azure\-based cloud solutions, integrating APIs, optimizing application performance, and ensuring secure, robust deployments. The role involves collaborating with cross\-functional teams, participating in code reviews, writing unit and integration tests, and contributing to architecture and technical design decisions. The developer will also troubleshoot production issues, maintain documentation, and continuously improve the codebase and development practices.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong Back\-End Web Development skills, including .NET Core, RESTful APIs, and database design.
* Proficiency in Front\-End Development using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).
* Experience in Software Development best practices, including testing, debugging, and version control (e.g., Git).
* Hands\-on Full\-Stack Development experience integrating front\-end and back\-end services in cloud environments.
* Practical experience with Azure services (App Services, Functions, Storage, SQL/NoSQL databases, DevOps pipelines).
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work effectively in remote, distributed teams, with strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies, CI/CD practices, security fundamentals, and performance optimization.
